title: Actions of Lie 2-algebras and comomentum maps
summary: In this paper we introduce the notion of a 2-action of a Lie 2-algebra on an arbitrary manifold M. Furthermore, in [Rog12], given a n-plectic manifold (M, $ω$), the authors consider a Lie Infinity-algebra L$\infty$ (M, $ω$), which is a higher analogue of the Poisson algebra of observables associated to a symplectic manifold. This Lie Infinity-algebra reduces to a Lie 2-algebra L^2 (M, $ω$) when (M, $ω$) is 2-plectic. Following ideas of N.L.
